visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with wavy dark hair, wearing an oversized purple and grey t-shirt with 'Lazy Monday' text, stands in an indoor studio with white walls. She has a neutral expression and looks slightly off-camera while holding a smartphone with a colorful stickered case. The lighting is bright and even. (2) She raises the phone to eye level, looking into the screen as if checking her appearance or preparing a selfie. The background remains a plain white wall with some studio equipment visible in the far distance. (3) A fast-paced montage begins. A still photo shows a woman in a black leather jacket, light blue top, and khaki skirt posing with arms raised in a high-angle shot within a modern indoor kitchen area. (4) Another still photo shows a young man with bleached blonde hair lying on a grey stone staircase, wearing a white tank top and metallic silver pants. (5) The woman from the first phase is shown lying on the same staircase in a nearly identical pose, wearing a black long-sleeve top and a grey skirt with glasses. (6) A close-up still shows a young man giving a thumbs-up gesture directly to the camera with a cheerful expression. (7) An extreme high-angle shot features a young man's face looking directly up at the lens with his hair falling forward. (8) The woman is then shown in an office chair, looking up in a similar top-down perspective, wearing glasses and a light blue top under a leather jacket. (9) A group of five young men in trendy streetwear pose against a purple-lit wall in a narrow hallway. (10) The woman is shown alone against the same wall, wearing a black dress and leaning in a similar stylized posture. (11) A wide-angle shot shows the woman sitting on a marble floor in jeans and a cardigan, legs extended toward the camera. (12) An extreme close-up of a man's face with a wide-eyed expression is shown, followed by the woman making a similar playfully distorted face in a close-up.
